{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the [[Military rank/Legends|military class]]|the [[Police officer/Legends|police counterpart]]}}
[[File:ImperialOfficers-TESB30.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Officers of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]]]
{{Quote|These boys are sloppy. There should always be an officer on duty.|[[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] to [[Clone Commander]] [[Cody]]|<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
An '''officer''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military class]] used in many organizations. Mostly, it denoted those placed in command of [[Soldier/Legends|enlisted soldiers]]. Some [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police forces]], such as the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], also used it as a low level [[police rank]] similar to that of [[Constable/Legends|constable]].

==Description==
Officers commanded [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and other personnel, giving them direction and making critical decisions. They were charged with making sure that the personnel under their command were fully aware of what was expected of them, and the goals and objectives of a mission or assignment. Officers were also expected to take responsibility for any failures. Low-ranking officers commanding soldiers were usually placed in charge of around a dozen personnel. Officers commanded more troops as they rose through the ranks and higher-ranking officers were placed in command of other officers.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

One of the foremost traditions of the galactic military was that an officer should command from the front. Officers should never issue orders that they would not be willing to undertake themselves. In an ideal environment, that meant [[Army/Legends|army]] officers charged with their soldiers into combat and [[Navy/Legends|naval]] officers commanded their ships at the forefront of naval engagements. Officers were expected to be comfortable taking command of others, dispensing guidance and making tough decisions such as ordering personnel to their deaths during combat. The best officers were capable of making these decisions without hesitation, not letting it paralyze them when others counted on them. These officers only reflected on the consequences of their actions after the fact, usually when lives were no longer in danger. Officers who could not make these decisions usually did not stay in their position for very long as their shortcomings were recognized, but some managed to shift the blame for the failures onto others.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

In general, officers were not well respected by the personnel under their command. They were frequently disrespected by their subordinates for a variety of reasons. Some saw their position and uniform as a symbol of oppression. Others, such as soldiers, did not believe they were honorable. Some officers did manage to rise above all the expectations and win the respect of not only those under their command but also their superiors. These officers enshrined the concepts of leadership and valor, often becoming renowned [[tactician]]s who were respected by their allies and enemies alike.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

==History==
Many officers came from families that saw military service as a tradition, with members serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for twenty generations or even longer. As the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] began to take hold with the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], officers in the new [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] had a decision to make. Many clung to the idea of proud service, believing that the honor of the military would win out over the ugly and dirty politics of the new regime. They remained at their posts aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and ground units. Others, unwilling to serve a military being corrupted by the New Order, [[Desertion/Legends|defected]] and joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="RPG-Core" />

==Behind the scenes==
Officer was one the five prestige classes detailed in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RPG-Core" /> 

Officer is one of the professions players of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' may choose to play. It was added with the ''New Game Enhancements'' and is an evolution of the previous squad leader profession. Officers provide [[Stimpack/Legends|stimpaks]] and increase the combat performance of their party.
